summary: A dense Goan classifieds page: eight justified columns under vermilion category bars with white condensed caps, punctuated by tall boxed displays in heavy condensed type (Portuguese passports, flats for sale, marine jobs).

frame.footer: CLASS CONTD ON PG 6 in a blue bar; CMYK colour strip along the bottom edge.

headers.notes: Bright red-orange bar, white condensed bold caps, a thin rule under it. Same bar used for every classification (PERSONAL, PEST CONTROL, SITUATIONS VACANT).

units.notes: Tight justified Times-like text, lead words in bold, phone numbers at the end; no codes.
Heavy condensed caps head (Impact-like), reverse blocks for key lines, script for company names, big phone numbers.
Black or tinted blocks with white condensed caps and italic body inside.

notes: Groups with The Tribune (cl-038): same dense justified liner texture, here with spot-colour bars instead of plain caps.
